judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation, leaving two of its own facets unchecked and committing `.lore/dod.md`. In `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, it uses `import Ajv from 'ajv'` (which often fails NodeNext typechecking without `import {Ajv} from 'ajv'`) and `(e as any).dataPath`, which triggers eslint's `no-explicit-any` rule and fails the `--max-warnings 0` acceptance criterion. Most required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` (extra property pass-through, dynamic schema updates, static compilation count, unknown tool throw) and the test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing, placed partially in an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` instead. Finally, none of the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, or the one-line JSDoc on `execute` were performed, and the `CHANGELOG.md` entry is incomplete.
